subject: Implementation: SDK bootstrap + endpoint switchboard & graceful throttling plan
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@stratopay.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation kickoff — SDK bootstrap, endpoint migration window, retry/backoff and quota handling

Hi Grace / Monica,

Thanks for taking this on. We're prepping StratoPay to switch from our legacy endpoint to Redwood's hosted inference for our fraud-scoring pipeline. High-level asks:

- Quick SDK bootstrap guide we can hand to our backend team (Node + Go samples).
- A low-risk endpoint migration plan (aiming for zero-downtime cutover).
- Recommended client retry/backoff patterns for 429s/500s and guidance on idempotency.
- Practical rate limit thresholds to configure client-side circuit breakers (we're currently 120 rps sustained with 350 rps short bursts).

Attached: stratopay-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (worksheet with proposed dates & owners).

Can you confirm who from Redwood will own the rollback and whether we need an SLA exception for the cutover window?

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of Integrations
StratoPay

--
Attachment: stratopay-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@stratopay.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@stratopay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff — SDK bootstrap, endpoint migration window, retry/backoff and quota handling

Alex — thanks for the clear list. Monica and I will lead the PM and CS side; Vivek will cover runtime specifics. Quick answers up front:

- SDK bootstrap: we'll share a compressed sample bundle (Node / Go / Python) and a one-page quickstart for token auth and connection pooling.
- Migration: recommend a staged switchboard approach (canary -> gradual ramp -> DNS cutover) to avoid a hard cut.
- Retries/backoff: Redwood recommends exponential backoff with full jitter, initial delay 200ms, max delay 10s, max attempts 6. For non-idempotent write calls use idempotency keys; read/generation calls can be retried safely if you detect incomplete responses.
- Rate limits: we'll provide a per-API threshold for your plan; short guidance is to surface 429s to a client-side token bucket and degrade non-critical requests first.

I'll attach the mutual action plan template with owners filled in. Can you confirm your desired migration weekend (we typically reserve a 3–4 hour low-traffic window)?

Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood-sdk-samples.tar.gz (stub)
Related: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3example-MAP

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@stratopay.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@stratopay.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff — SDK bootstrap, endpoint migration window, retry/backoff and quota handling

Thanks Vivek — that pattern looks good. A couple quick clarifications:

- Our legal team wants an explicit SLA exception for the migration window (they prefer 4 hours). Is that straightforward to get?
- For the dual-write verification, we need a small harness that compares top-K responses and flags regressions. Can Redwood provide a lightweight comparator or should we build it?

If you can confirm both, we'll lock dates and assign owners in the MAP.

Alex

--
Attachment: stratopay-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (updated stub)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@stratopay.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff — SDK bootstrap, endpoint migration window, retry/backoff and quota handling

Alex — looping in the MAP and the canary checklist. Summary of what's agreed so far and next steps: 

MAP excerpt (owners):
- Migration window: proposed 2026-06-08 02:00–05:00 UTC (Owner: StratoPay SRE; Redwood CS lead: Grace).
- Canary: 5% traffic for 24h, validate latency/accuracy/regressions (Owner: StratoPay Integrations).
- Rollback: Redwood SRE will execute DNS revert + kill-switch if error budget >5% in 30 minutes.
- SLAs: we'll request a temporary SLA exception for the window; I'll open the ticket with Support/Legal and link the DocuSign request.

Canary checklist:
- Smoke deploy to staging with SDK samples (done).
- Telemetry hooks added (x-redwood-request-id, X-Cloud-TraceContext).
- Comparator harness: Redwood can provide a small comparator (Python script) to do top-K diffs; sending as an attachment.
- Agree acceptance criteria: median latency < 250ms, error rate < 0.5%, no NLU accuracy regressions >2% (per signed-off prompt set).

Next actions: I'll attach the canary-checklist.pdf and open the SLA exception. Please confirm acceptance criteria and I will send DocuSign for the MAP owners.

Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: canary-checklist.pdf (stub)
Related: https://app.docusign.com/agreements/0a1b2c3d-example

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@stratopay.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff — SDK bootstrap, endpoint migration window, retry/backoff and quota handling

All — quick wrap and confirmation:

- Migration window locked: 2026-06-08 02:00–05:00 UTC. Redwood will request SLA exception for that 3-hour window; Monica has opened the ticket.
- Canary plan: 5% traffic for 24h, acceptance criteria as Monica listed. StratoPay to run comparator harness; Redwood will supply the comparator script and help with verification.
- Retry policy: exponential backoff + full jitter, initial 200ms, max delay 10s, max attempts 6. Respect Retry-After when present.
- Rate limits: based on current plan, we'll provide a per-route burst threshold in a separate doc by EOD tomorrow.
- Owners: StratoPay SRE leads rollback, Redwood SRE on standby and will execute the kill-switch if needed.

I'll share the final MAP and DocuSign link once Monica confirms SLA is in motion. Thanks everyone — happy to run a 30-minute dry-run with your SRE next week.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
